finishing.note: one UV set (smart project over every part, the card on its own 0-1); 3 PNGs (AO, roughness and metal in ORM, a diffuse-colour base, the glow card); 5 slots (agent_shell, agent_joint, agent_glow, agent_hood_inner, agent_glow_card): the lens is its own convex disc with a clean edge (no texture mask), seated in a stepped reflector, the glow card has its own slot; a panel seam (0.6 mm deep, 0.8 mm wide grooves) round the hood (the body cone is seamless, as the concept's), a rolled half-round hood lip, axle drums with caps and screw heads at every joint, bevels on the collar, rings, slit and drums, smooth shading with weighted normals on the joints; rig body, head, arm_l_upper, arm_l_lower, arm_r_upper, arm_r_lower rigid, 4 actions (asking, resting, speaking, working); evidence rendered with EEVEE under a dark studio rig (cool table light from below, warm point light inside the hood, warm practical, cool rim) with a bloom pass and no depth of field; every file under 10 MB

generator.method: scripted Blender build, no image-to-3D: scripts/art/lamp/build_agent.bpy (Blender 5.2.2 arm64, bpy, headless)
generator.reference: the picked concept option H-s41 and the turnaround in options/, matched by eye in evidence/target-compare.jpg against reference/target-crop.png
generator.why_not_trellis: The figure is about 15 rounded primitives (a hood cup, an orb, a cone, capsules, balls, wire loops). The 2026-10-21 TRELLIS.2 run of the old lamp needed 3 seeds (two lost or split the arm), left 26 open edges and a ragged per-face glow edge, and its texture was thrown away; thin arms and a 1 mm wire loop are what image-to-3D fuses or drops. A script gives exact rigid parts per bone, a clean separate emissive orb and a unique UV for the AO bake. TRELLIS.2 was therefore not run for this build (research r1, r2 and r5 of 2026-10-24 expect the same).

tris_note: 14730 against 15000 (static working pose; the rigged final.fbx carries the same 14730)
materials: agent_shell: white clear-coat plastic (hood outside and its rolled lip, the smooth seamless body cone, arm capsules, the wire loops); base colour 0.80/0.79/0.77 linear, roughness 0.35 with a smudge-noise breakup of ±0.07 (albedo ±2 %) baked into ORM.G, clear coat 1.0 at roughness 0.08 (r4: albedo about 0.8, a second specular lobe)

agent_hood_inner: the inside of the hood and the lens's stepped reflector cone, the concept's warm-lit bowl round the lens; base 0.26/0.18/0.11 linear (a warm tan the warm light turns orange), roughness 0.32 ±0.08 (baked), half clear coat; no self-glow in the bake. UE: roughness from ORM.G, GlowStrength x 0.15 adds the warm bounce

agent_joint: dark metal joint hardware (axle drums with caps and domed screw heads at shoulder, elbow and wrist; shoulder brackets; collar rings at the capsule ends; neck rings and collar; the cable); #3A3D42, roughness 0.38 ±0.1, metal 1

agent_glow: amber emissive lens face (a 7.3 cm disc domed 3.5 mm, set 2.92 cm back from the hood's mouth, its axis 14 degrees above the opening's) with its raised 2 mm rim bead, the front slit, dot and pin; base nearly black (light, not paint: the warm light in front must not wash it to cream), #FFA94D x3 (UE drives GlowStrength per state)

agent_glow_card: the additive card just in front of the lens, as wide as the reflector, textures/agent_glow_card.png (white on black: a soft hotspot in the middle, a bright ring on the lens edge, a short falloff onto the reflector) tinted by the glow colour; UE: unlit additive, two-sided, no depth write, at about 5/3 of the lens emission (the evidence renders use 5 against the lens 3)
textures: textures/agent_basecolor.png, textures/agent_glow_card.png, textures/agent_orm.png: agent_basecolor.png (diffuse colour bake, sRGB) and agent_orm.png (R ambient occlusion, G roughness, B metal; linear), 2048 px, baked with Cycles on the CPU at 64 samples in 57.1 s (AO mean 0.286, self-occlusion only: hood over orb and collar, joints into capsules, the seam grooves). ORM.G carries the roughness breakup. No normal map: seams, lip, drums and screws are real geometry with smooth shading. agent_glow_card.png 256 px. UE: BaseColor x lerp(1, AO, 0.6), because the forward path's SSAO is weak and there is no reflection capture (r4); the Blender materials of final.fbx are wired that way.

bounds_cm.note: final_working.glb in Blender axes (x width, y depth with the figure facing -y, z up), WORKING pose: the right arm hangs below the pin tip and the left arm reaches 22 cm out to +x and 14 cm forward, so the box is not centred; rest pose height pin tip to hood top 23.45 cm

lamp-agent.note: 37 rigid parts plus the glow card (a single quad, whose 4 boundary edges are the open edges)

pivot: the tip of the pin under the body (rest pose z = 0), on the body axis (x = y = 0); the figure hovers, so placement sets the pivot height above the table
axes: Blender Z up, the figure faces -Y (the hood opening looks -Y and 40 degrees down). glTF (final_working.glb) is Y-up with the figure facing +Z; UE Interchange turns either into Z-up with the figure facing UE +Y (as the old lamp-agent FBX landed: Blender -Y onto UE +Y). Yaw it 90 degrees less than "facing +X" needs; check one frame.

rig.weights: rigid: every vertex weight 1.0 to the one bone of its part (one rigid part per bone), except the cable's 168 vertices, blended body -> arm_r_upper along its length (smoothstep) so a pose bends it instead of tearing it
rig.contract_change: The 2026-10-21 contract was base > lower_arm > upper_arm > head (one arm, a desk lamp). The target character has two arms, so the contract is now body > head, body > arm_l_upper > arm_l_lower, body > arm_r_upper > arm_r_lower; arm_l is the figure's left (+X, the viewer's right). The UE AnimBP aims the head bone, as before.

placement.ue_choice: place final_working.glb as a STATIC mesh (5 sections = 5 draws, no skinning) for the capture; keep final.fbx (skeletal, 6 bones, 4 actions) for L5.7 states. The old SK_LampAgent placement drew 6 sections.
placement.where: hovering above the far edge of the table, centred a little left of the table centre, the hood facing the player (a yaw so the figure's -Y looks at the camera); in the 1600 x 900 target capture the head sits in the upper third, at about 46 % of the width, the hood about 7.6 % of the frame width across (the target crop: 1376 x 768 frame, hood centre at x = 645, y = 55, hood about 105 px wide). The target pose's frame top is only 1.6 degrees below its eye (43 cm over the table top, pitch -31, hfov 90), so the hood top must stay under the eye: with the figure about 103 cm in front of the eye, scale 1.05 and the pin tip 12.8 cm over the table put the hood top 3 % below the frame top, the orb centre 10 % down and the hood 7.6 % across (at scale 1.2 the pin tip goes to 9.3 cm). Working-pose hood top: 23.39 cm over the pin tip
placement.light: a warm point light just in front of the hood's mouth (build.json orb_centre_rest_m, the lens face's centre, + 4.5 cm along open_axis, carried by the head bone), about #FFA85A, small source radius, short attenuation (about 40 cm) so it lights the hood inside, the body top and the arms, plus the card; and a faint cool rim from behind so the white silhouette separates from the dark room (r5: the old lamp dissolved into the background)

working_pose.note: the static working pose (final_working.glb), Blender axes: the lens face's centre (kept under the old key), the opening axis and the warm light 4.5 cm in front of the lens
